intro: Our complaints procedure explains what to do if you’re unhappy with our service. We take every complaint seriously and aim to put things right quickly.
body: How to complain: email or write to us with your name, your application reference if you have one, and what went wrong. You can also call us and we’ll make a note of your complaint.
What happens next: we’ll acknowledge your complaint within 3 working days and aim to give you a full response within 14 days. If we need longer, we’ll tell you why.
If you’re still not satisfied, tell us and a senior member of the team will review your complaint and the response.
title: Complaints Procedure | Indian e-Visa Online Service
description: Our complaints procedure: how to make a complaint about our Indian visa service, how quickly we respond and what happens if you are not satisfied.

sections.heading: Before using the complaints procedure
sections.text: Often a quick call sorts things out. If your concern is about the progress of an application, call us first and we’ll check its status with you.

faqs.q: How long does the complaints procedure take?
faqs.a: We acknowledge complaints within 3 working days and aim to reply in full within 14 days.
Yes. We’ll make a note of your complaint and confirm it in writing.
A senior member of the team will review your complaint and our response.
